title: The truth about AI replacing radiologists

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: Will AI replace radiologists, or will it redefine their role in healthcare?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: AI now assists with image analysis, like detecting tumors in CT scans, but lacks clinical judgment and patient context.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Over-reliance on AI could erode diagnostic skills and create ethical risks if errors go undetected in underserved regions.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are integrating explainable AI and hybrid systems that let radiologists review and override AI decisions in real time.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: In the future, AI could handle routine imaging, freeing radiologists for complex cases and patient-centered care.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future isn’t replacement—it’s collaboration, with AI enhancing human expertise in medicine.

video_cue: A radiologist reviewing an AI-assisted scan, with holographic data overlay in a modern hospital.
